reason: Calibration population/granularity was unspecified in v1 (status: PROCEDURE_FROZEN_NOT_YET_EXECUTABLE) and, separately, the workload-manifest design that preceded this file assumed a per-source 40-window concatenation. Forensic inspection of Phase-12's own execution code (src/robustbench/ranking_portability/execute_cell.py: fresh Simulator + policy.reset() per (source,window,region,policy,repetition) cell; ranking_portability/analysis/ranking_analysis.py: bootstrap resampling performed over windows, '(policy,window) rows treated as independent') found each of the 120 frozen windows is Phase-12's own independent unit, each with its own lambda_ref. Resolved outcome-blind, before any real calibration measurement: calibration runs per window, never per concatenated source trace. v1 is left in place, unmodified, as an immutable historical record -- not deleted, not silently overwritten.

not_used: the full 8,000-request per-source concatenation as one calibration unit
averaging lambda_ref across windows before defining HIGH_PRESSURE
calibration_population.source_of_decision: docs/RQ6_REAL_VLLM_SCIENTIFIC_PROTOCOL_20260902.md, 'Calibration population' section, frozen 2026-09-03 before any real calibration measurement

reference_policy_rationale: Unchanged from v1: mirrors the simulator's fifo reference (docs/LOAD_CALIBRATION_PROTOCOL.md): simplest mechanism, no priority/deadline synthesis dependency. Already built and validated (Wulver job 1219334, pass_gate=true, --scheduling-policy fcfs, no --scheduler-cls).

region_grid.granularity: one lambda_ref per (source, window) -- unchanged from Phase-12's own region_assignment_index, which has 120 distinct lambda_ref values (verified 2026-09-03: all 120 HIGH_PRESSURE entries have absolute_load_factor == 1.5 x lambda_ref exactly)

knee_search.criterion: slo_violation_rate_real(factor) crosses fixed threshold, measured against exactly one window's 200 requests per candidate
knee_search.source_of_definition: src/robustbench/ranking_portability/calibration.py::compute_lambda_ref (Phase-11, frozen); reused as a search-shape definition only, never its numeric lambda_ref result. Mirrored exactly (unchanged from v1) in src/robustbench/real_llm/rq6_calibration.py::bisect_lambda_ref_real.
knee_search.output: real_lambda_ref(source, window); real_HIGH_PRESSURE(source, window) = 1.5 x real_lambda_ref(source, window)

timing_transformation.formula: real_arrival_i = base_relative_arrival_i / s;  real_slo_deadline_i = real_arrival_i + (base_slo_deadline_i - base_relative_arrival_i) / s
timing_transformation.s: the bisection candidate factor for this window
timing_transformation.base_relative_arrival_i_source: workload manifest's per-window base_relative_arrival_s (already independently rebased to window-local t=0 and scaled by that window's own 1.5x lambda_ref, per the workload manifest's own frozen contract -- never a cross-window concatenation offset)

episode_reset_contract.mechanism: Sequential wait-for-all-responses replay: a window episode (and each bisection candidate within it) only returns after every one of its dispatched requests has already received an HTTP response from vLLM, so running/waiting queue depth is 0 by construction before the next candidate or window begins. Verified as a defense-in-depth check via vLLM's /metrics (vllm:num_requests_running, vllm:num_requests_waiting) before every candidate measurement (src/robustbench/real_llm/rq6_calibration.py::check_reset_barrier).
episode_reset_contract.prefix_cache_rule: --no-enable-prefix-caching passed explicitly at server start (scripts/real_vllm/run_rq6_calibration.py), so no KV-block reuse can leak across requests or windows regardless of prompt content overlap.
episode_reset_contract.kv_release: By the same sequential design: a request's KV blocks are released by vLLM once its response is returned, and no next request/candidate/window is dispatched until every prior one has returned.
episode_reset_contract.held_requests: None by construction -- no admission-control/priority-hold mechanism runs during calibration (only vllm_faithful's native FCFS).
episode_reset_contract.plugin_state: N/A for calibration -- vllm_faithful uses vLLM's native scheduler, no custom --scheduler-cls / plugin state to reset.
episode_reset_contract.request_id_isolation: Each candidate's requests are freshly constructed from the frozen manifest each time (src/robustbench/real_llm/rq6_calibration.py::replay_window_once) -- no counter or ID state persists across candidates/windows.
episode_reset_contract.engineering_validation: ENGINEERING_ONLY_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE local smoke (2026-09-03, local RTX 5060 Ti, Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct): 32-candidate bisection against a live vLLM server, reset barrier passed 32/32 candidates (running=0, waiting=0 every time), converged cleanly (CONVERGED, slo_violation_rate transitioned 0.0 -> 1.0 across candidates as expected).

slo_violation_rate_real_definition.formula: 1 - (sum(weight_i for i in completed if t_done_i <= slo_deadline_i) / sum(weight_i for i in completed))
slo_violation_rate_real_definition.t_done_source: vllm_openai_client.call_non_streaming, monotonic clock relative to this window-candidate's own dispatch start
slo_violation_rate_real_definition.slo_deadline_source: carried through unmodified from the frozen Phase-12 window's SYNTHESIZED_IMPUTED overlay (docs/DATA_FIELD_PROVENANCE.md), then time-scaled per this window's own candidate factor -- never resynthesized for the real run

output_token_execution_contract.rationale: Reproduces the frozen trace's decode-length footprint exactly rather than stopping at a natural EOS. predicted_output_tokens is never used as the execution cap.

failure_handling.rule: a candidate factor whose measurement run has zero completed requests (crash, timeout) is treated as slo_violation_rate = 1.0 for that factor

warmup.rule: one untimed warmup request per server start (i.e. once per window's calibration task, not once per candidate factor), discarded from all statistics

runner.array_index_mapping: deterministic sorted (source, window_id) enumeration across the three workload manifests (run_rq6_calibration.enumerate_calibration_units); array index i always names the same window across resubmissions given unchanged manifests
